annotations.title: Development-site search with presets and up to 12 filters

description:
Development-site search: land parcels in a place that match a named preset
    (infill, under_used, corporate_owned, outside_green_belt) and up to 12
    filters (size, built coverage, use, owner class and years owned, Green
    Belt, conservation area, brownfield register, flood zone). Each parcel has
    area, use, built coverage, recorded constraint flags and owner class
    (company name and number only for companies).

    A constraint flag that is null is NOT RECORDED for that parcel, not
    absent: never say a null parcel is outside the Green Belt. No local-plan
    allocation is held (that table is empty), so this is not a planning view.
    Do NOT use it for what land is worth: no land value, residual value or score is
    returned, and it does not appraise. For one known parcel use property tools.
    Charged only when at least one parcel is returned.
    Costs 40 credits (40p).

    `place` is exactly one of {uprn}, {postcode}, {area: {type, code}} or {geometry} (point + radius_m up to 2000, bbox up to 5 km, polygon up to 200 vertices); free text is refused, call resolve_place first.
    UK only. Limits: 25 parcels per page, a search area of at most 150 km2 (a
    county or country is refused: use a local authority or district); more via
    `next_cursor`; a page is cut to 8 KB. A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.

PlaceArg.description: Exactly one of uprn, postcode, area, geometry. Free text is refused: call resolve_place first.
PlaceArg.title: PlaceArg

code.description: Lowercase postcode district ('e5') or an ONS/GSS code ('E09000012').
code.title: Code

bbox.title: Bbox
